blueprint_numbers_marked_UNSOURCED.blueprint_vsa_dim_65536: nn.Linear(65536,65536) is 4.3e9 parameters, ~10x the entire 447M budget. NOT implemented. This module uses dim=4096 complex (8192 flat) to match every committed receipt.
blueprint_numbers_marked_UNSOURCED.blueprint_paths_wrong: blueprint names henri_core/novelty_gate.py and zone_a/ingress.py for the ingress; the real ingress is HENRI V2/henri_core/zone_a.py. Verified before editing.
blueprint_numbers_marked_UNSOURCED.blueprint_claims_NOT_verified: blueprint asserts 'Subsystem 1: SOLVED' and 'Subsystem 5: SOLVED'. A design document solves nothing; measured below.

adaptation_from_image_to_text.image_machinery_replaced: Conv2d / in_channels=3 / light-field -> Conv1d over the TOKEN axis (kernels 3,5,7). M4 is character-tokenized program text.
adaptation_from_image_to_text.global_avg_pool_avoided: the blueprint's ventral path ends in AdaptiveAvgPool2d((1,1)) = global average pooling, the SAME operator family measured to collapse participation ratio 26.21 -> 2.45. Not used in the order-sensitive path.
adaptation_from_image_to_text.disclosed_tension: the blueprint binds psi_scene = psi_id (*) psi_pose. HRR binding was measured WORSE than co-storage for the engram store (0.0463 vs 0.1667). That was a memory result, not an ingress result, but it is an adversarial data point, not a free choice. A bound-vs-concat ablation is implemented (bind flag) and NOT yet run.

K1_gradient_reach.defect_found_and_fixed_in_the_TEST: first draft scored 19/22. The 3 silent params were neuromod (2) and tangent.generator (1): gamma and eps were COMPUTED but never entered the objective. An unused head cannot receive gradient. The objective now exercises every sub-module.
K1_gradient_reach.significance: This is the repair of the measured dead-flag defect class. Legacy wave_of is no_grad-wrapped, encode_text() returns requires_grad=False even called directly, and the path severs at argmax(routes)->int + frozen angle buffer + constant-magnitude polar. A conv->phase map IS differentiable end to end. That specific defect is fixed.

K4_order_sensitivity.bar: <0.99, pre-registered, NOT moved after the fact
K4_order_sensitivity.SELF_CAUGHT_INVERSION: my attempted repair made this WORSE: first draft 0.988987 -> after adding a fixed position phase ramp 0.998836. The repair is FALSIFIED. Root cause (hypothesis, not measured): to_phase outputs large-magnitude phases, so exp(i*phase) for the two positions shares a dominant common component and the aggregate is nearly order-invariant.
K4_order_sensitivity.consequence: this module is MORE order-blind than the legacy path it would replace. Legacy cos(IR,RI)=0.0 separates order fully.

E1_predictive_measurement.reading: cortical is ABOVE the floor (carries real signal) but BELOW legacy. The VCNet-derived ingress does not beat the path it would replace on held-out token accuracy.

verdict_plain: The cortical ingress repairs the DIFFERENTIABILITY defect (K1 22/22, a real structural gain) but FAILS order sensitivity (K4) and does NOT improve accuracy (E1 -0.0162 vs legacy). It must NOT be promoted. The blueprint's 'Subsystem 1: SOLVED' is FALSIFIED as implemented here.
what_is_established: OBSERVED: the pooling stage is not the accuracy lever (POOLING_NOT_THE_LEVER, PR 2.24->27.09 at 12.1x with accuracy +0.0014).
OBSERVED: the accuracy limit is upstream of pooling.
OBSERVED: a differentiable text->wave path CAN be built (K1 22/22), unlike the legacy argmax/buffer/polar path.
FALSIFIED: this particular cortical implementation is order-preserving. It is not.
FALSIFIED: this cortical ingress improves held-out accuracy. It does not.

next_gate.cheapest_next_repair: Fix the order channel BEFORE aggregation: apply position coding to the PHASE (not the wave) or use learned position embeddings, then re-run K4. Prediction: cos(IR,RI) can be driven below 0.5 without touching accuracy.
next_gate.then: Re-test E1. Only if E1 exceeds legacy + 0.02 does the cortical-family ingress earn further work.
next_gate.do_not: Do not wire the tangent error into the Sagnac veto (blueprint Directive 3) until (a) the ingress beats legacy and (b) the veto is ATTRIBUTABLE. 11,340 labeled-rejection pairs exist as the label source for that later step.

what_this_does_not_buy: No promotion. No model-performance claim. CPU, D=4096, diagnostic only. 'Yield a successful project HENRI model' is not satisfied: M4-G1 still fails.
